verdict.rationale: Supabase's official MCP server gives agents an `execute_sql` tool and `apply_migration` against a full Postgres database, so an AI agent can run set-based statements that touch many rows in one call. However, no evidence explicitly documents bulk or batch operations as a feature, or covers limits, safeguards or batch semantics for large multi-item changes. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of bulk/batch operations (e.g. batch insert/update/delete APIs or agent bulk-edit guidance), documented limits and safety controls for mass changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Once connected, your agent can call tools to query data, run migrations, deploy Edge Functions, and more.
Every project is **a full Postgres database**
Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.
